instruction: `capitalize_words` in `textutils/words.py` returns the words unchanged instead of capitalizing the first letter and lowercasing the rest. For input `hELLO wORLD` it returns `hELLO wORLD` instead of `Hello World`.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils/words.py b/textutils/words.py
--- a/textutils/words.py
+++ b/textutils/words.py
@@ -19,7 +19,7 @@
     ``"hELLO wORLD"`` -> ``"Hello World"``.
     """
     words = split_words(text)
-    return " ".join(words)
+    return " ".join(word.capitalize() for word in words)
